question.text: Ms. Anita Desai, CFO at Aravalli Long-Short Fund (Cat III onshore), is provisioning GST on management fees paid to the Investment Manager. The applicable GST rate per Chapter 14 is:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states: 'GST at the rate of 18% would be levied on fees if any, payable towards investment management fee and Trusteeship Fees payable by the Fund to the Investment Manager and Trustee, respectively.' GST is a direct cost to the fund (borne by LPs via NAV). The Trap: 5%/12%/28% are other GST slabs used as distractors. Financial services default to the 18% standard rate. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/XIX-B (Distributor exams) test the same 18% on distributor commissions (though commissions often get ITC or exemption depending on structure). XIX-E drills the fund-level cost impact. Manager's Pro-Tip: Model GST 18% on mgmt fee as explicit NAV drag. If Aravalli charges 2% mgmt fee, LPs actually pay 2 × 1.18 = 2.36% of AUM annually. Inside GIFT-IFSC, fees invoiced to non-resident LPs are zero-rated — another reason the IFSC route is aggressively marketed.
